THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: BD/BD/LND/3/5/46. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Lands.: 4-3/9/2016/WS/508. I, hereby give notice to the Sub - Sections (1) of the Section (7) of the Land Acquisition Act the lands described below is required by the Government and the Government intends to acquire the said Lands for public purpose:
Description of the lands to be Acquired:

The land described below, 0.0126 Hectares in extent mentioned as Lot No. 1 in the P.P.B. 756, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Badulla East Village (within the Division 06 of Badulla Municipality), 78 B Badulla East Grama Niladhari Division, Rilpola Korale in Badulla Divisional Secretary Division of Badulla District in the Province of Uva.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Oyawelana; Name of the Claimant : Cannot be found; Description of Land : Temporary mix cultivation ; Extent : 0.0126 Hectare.
To the North : Road (Road Development Authority) and Oyawelana watte where the claimant cannot be found; To

All those who claim ownership, interest and any other connection to aforesaid lands, should appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Badulla at below mentioned time:
Inquiry Date Time Lot No. 08.08.2024 10.00 a.m. 1

In addition, hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies of the nature of their interests in the land/ lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said Land, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount before 01.08.2024.

AMENDMENT THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Ref. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/8/2013/pc/595. My Ref. No.: KDS/UNU/4/6/LA/Pra.s/Road. IN the Notice under Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, which was published by me in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2365/74 dated 06.01.2024, I hereby, inform that the inquiry dates should be corrected as follows : All persons interest, in the aforesaid land/ lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby acquired to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing,

before me at Divisional Secretariat, Udunuwara 07th August, 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 1st August 2024, nature if their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/ servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. T. P. Sඎආൺඇൺඌൾ඄ൺඋൺ, Divisional Secretary, Udunuwara. At Udunuwara Divisional Secretariat, 24th June, 2024. EOG 07-0015
